graph.title: IKEA LACK side table — assembly

steps.title: Unpack and flip the table top
steps.instruction: Place the table top upside down on a soft surface so the four threaded inserts face up.

steps.title: Thread the first two legs
steps.instruction: Screw two opposite legs into the inserts by hand until they seat. Do not cross-thread.

steps.title: Fit the remaining legs and stand the table
steps.instruction: Screw in the last two legs. Flip the table onto its legs and check it does not rock.

notes: From the IKEA 3D Assembly Dataset (Inter IKEA Systems B.V.).
